children: Rajeh Maamoun, an officer and President of Arch Capital Group, sold 48,661 common shares on November 10, 2026, at weighted average prices ranging from $107.5316 to $109.2791 per share. The transactions totaled approximately $5,281,897. Following the transactions, Maamoun directly owned 418,645 common shares and indirectly owned 40,600 common shares through an LLC.
